evidence.title: Backgrounds Supply | Jaw-Dropping Backgrounds for Your Projects

name: Backgrounds Supply
summary: Library of 1,359 gradient, AI-generated and animated MP4 backgrounds across 31 collections, unlocked with a $49 one-time payment.
description: Curated background art for hero sections, presentations, wallpapers and social posts: handcrafted gradient and AI-generated abstract backgrounds as 16:9 PNGs at roughly 3K (a subset at 4K), plus 36 looping MP4 video backgrounds. A single $49 payment unlocks the library and all future drops; a free pack and a free in-browser Gradient Lab are also available.
contains: $49 one-time payment, lifetime access including future drops
free pack of ~100 backgrounds with email sign-up
Gradient Lab: free in-browser gradient/shader tool, PNG and MP4 export up to 4K
drops into Figma, Framer, Photoshop, Canva, Webflow, After Effects
